''See also: [[Heart of Nakothi Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Heart of [[Nakothi]], also known as [[Nakothi]]'s Heart, is a gray-green, fist-sized organ belonging to the [[Great Elder]] known as the [[Dead Mother]]. It is a powerful and dangerous remnant that possesses a conscious, malicious will and can emit a deafening, shrill song. The Heart is capable of exerting immense influence over those nearby, including driving individuals to madness or compelling them to prostrate themselves before its power. It has the potential to transform people into [[Children of Nakothi]] and, if destroyed without first being weakened or having its power drained, could release enough energy to kill and resurrect everyone in the vicinity as part of [[Nakothi]]'s will. Historically, the Emperor used a Heart of [[Nakothi]] to achieve immortality and stave off death. The object is highly coveted for its immense power, serving as a valuable commodity for trade or a tool for survival. However, the Heart is also volatile; it can grow in strength over time and may attempt to corrupt or bind itself to a host. While there is more than one such heart in existence, the specific Heart discussed has been handled by various figures, including [[Naberius Clayborn|Naberius]], [[Shera]], and [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]], eventually being cast into the [[Aion Sea]].}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The Heart of [[Nakothi]] is a vile artifact belonging to the [[Dead Mother]] that functions as an organ capable of squirting gray-green [[blood]]. As a tool used to bind or raise an Emperor, the object is highly sought after by those wishing to crown a new ruler. Although the Emperor managed to keep the Heart at bay for over fifteen hundred years, it was later seen being clutched by the Chronicler and proved indispensable for a crew attempting to escape the gallows. The singing artifact can be bonded with, yet it possesses the power to erode the mind and pry at a person's senses. After [[Naberius Clayborn]] raised the increasingly strong Heart into the air, its influence ultimately eroded his mind before [[Shera]] took possession of it.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Heart of [[Nakothi]] is a fist-sized, pulsing mass characterized by its gray color, green veins, and the sludge it pumps. While the [[Blackwatch]] hunts for this object, [[Shera]] seeks to keep it buried or destroyed to prevent it from escaping into the world. During a mission involving [[Meia]], [[Watchmen]] are discovered digging at the Heart, which is eventually held by [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] as it is cut free from its bonds. This malicious entity, which can be heard crooning songs and whispering messages, has allowed the Emperor to live forever for centuries. Although it can be restrained with invested rags or kept in a pewter cage, destroying the Heart with a [[left-hand shear]] risks releasing [[Nakothi]]'s will and potentially killing or resurrecting everyone on the island.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Heart of [[Nakothi]] was first described by [[Jerri]] as a comparison for a mass of gray-green flesh. During the course of events, [[Calder]] threw the object into the sea before later delivering it. The Heart was ultimately utilized in the construction of an organism created by [[Kelarac]], a process that became involved in a debacle.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Heart of Nakothi|Nakothi's Heart]] was used to build the organism [[Kelarac]] created.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Although the [[Consultants]] have been aware of the Heart of [[Nakothi]] for many years, the entity unexpectedly vanished. This artifact possesses a voice similar to [[Syphren]]'s and croons a terrible song while whispering of its desire to be reborn. [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] eventually assisted in unearthing a second Heart of [[Nakothi]], which serves as a component capable of resurrecting the Emperor through the power of the [[Dead Mother]]. However, there remains a danger that the Emperor might lose himself to the Heart during this process.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Consultants]] have known about the [[Heart of Nakothi]] for years.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c3">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 3</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Heart of Nakothi]] has vanished.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c4">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The Emperor might lose himself to the [[Heart of Nakothi]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c5">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Syphren]]'s voice is similar to the [[Heart of Nakothi]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c8">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] helped unearth the second [[Heart of Nakothi]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c13">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Heart of Nakothi|Nakothi's Heart]] is a component that can bring the Emperor back to life via the [[Dead Mother]]'s power.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c14">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Heart of Nakothi]] is an entity that croons a terrible song and whispers to be reborn.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c20">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“Another Heart of Nakothi. We can’t very well raise a mortal man Emperor, can we?”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9" />}}

* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|“We’ve known about the Heart of Nakothi for years,” Yala said, tapping two fingers against her collarbone.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c3" />}}
